title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations, New Verticals – Retail (South and Central)

In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt’s 3rd Party (3P) Retail business is a core pillar of New Verticals, giving customers access to grocery, convenience, pharmacy, and specialty retail through strong partnerships with merchants across markets. Our vision is to make Wolt the world’s best shopping mall, in your pocket.</p> <p>We at Wolt have a slightly different take on what a strategy team delivers, compared with traditional, larger corporations. It’s a little more hands-on (don’t worry, that’s what makes it exciting!). We work closely with cross-functional teams to build solid growth plans, execute them well in our country operations, and spread best practices across the organization – all with the goal of keeping the growing pains of rapid scaling in check.</p> <p>As Wolt continues to scale its 3P Retail business across the South and Central region, we’re looking for a Strategy &amp; Operations Manager to drive sustainable topline growth and bottomline performance. You’ll work closely with the Regional GM for 3P Retail, Heads of Retail across country clusters, and Account Management / sales teams on the ground – and partner with Marketing, Finance, Commercial, and other global functional teams to align strategy, planning, and execution.</p> <p>We’ve learned over the years that there’s an abundance of strategic thinkers out there, but for this role we need a strategic doer. We have data on anything and everything, so we can and will make every decision through analysis – what we don’t need is death by Powerpoint. Planning should be decisive, quick, and efficient, so we can move on to the real challenge: execution.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own topline (GOV, orders, merchant expansion, basket size) and bottomline (contribution margin, profitability, cost efficiency) performance across the region, partnering closely with the Regional GM, Heads of Retail, and country teams – identifying performance gaps, diagnosing root causes, and driving corrective action</li> <li>Partner with Finance on regional planning, forecasting, and target setting, and help shape long-term growth plans, expansion strategies, and investment priorities across the region</li> <li>Work with Heads of Retail and Key Account Management teams to unlock growth opportunities with merchant partners, including merchant expansion strategy and priority categories and markets</li> <li>Partner with Marketing on growth initiatives across acquisition, retention, and basket size expansion, and build scalable playbooks that drive consistent growth across markets</li> <li>Lead cross-functional projects end-to-end – from problem definition to execution and impact measurement – alongside Marketing, Commercial, and Analytics, ensuring global strategy and local execution stay aligned</li> <li>Use Cursor, Claude, Looker, Excel, and other BI tools to turn business performance data into dashboards, models, and clear strategic recommendations for regional and global leadership</li> <li>Support experimentation and test-and-learn approaches to keep optimizing growth and profitability</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li>4+ years of relevant experience in Strategy &amp; Operations, management consulting, investment banking, tech companies, or high-growth retail/e-commerce – ideally with exposure to multi-country or regional business environments and merchant-facing or commercial teams</li> <li>Brilliant data analysis skills – an exceptional ability to frame and synthesize complex, ambiguous business problems into clear, concise solutions. Advanced Cursor/Claude + Excel (financial modelling, forecasting, scenario analysis) and solid experience with BI tools like Looker; SQL is a plus but not required</li> <li>Outstanding structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot high-impact opportunities, prioritize effectively, and connect strategy to commercial and operational execution</li> <li>Natural tendency for ownership: we grow quickly, everyone has more to do than time allows, and just because something’s not in your job description doesn’t mean you shouldn’t do it</li> <li>Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders – Regional GMs, Heads of Retail, and global functional leaders – and to influence without authority across global, regional, and local teams</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives end-to-end and managing multiple priorities and workstreams at once</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with an eye for detail and a passion for presenting data in clear, compelling ways. You’ll be working at a rapid pace across country teams in several time zones – it’s not easy ;-)</li> <li>Experience from high-growth VC/PE-backed companies is a plus</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Next Steps</strong></h2> <p>If you’re excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an ambitious team redefining retail, click below to apply and get the conversation going! Along with a competitive salary and benefits, you’ll also be eligible for our stock option plan.</p> <p>We’ll be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Director of Talent Acquisition (f/m/d)
description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Location: Role is Hybrid and based in either Berlin or Darmstadt, Germany, with remote flexibility. Your Role We're hiring a Director of Talent Acquisition to own how this company hires. This isn't a caretaker role over a recruiting queue. You'll lead our Talent Acquisition and Employer Branding function — a team of five TA Partners and a TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — and build the operating model that makes hiring a genuine competitive advantage. You're joining at a pivotal moment. The TA function is operational and delivering, but quality, consistency, and hiring manager capability haven't yet caught up with our ambitions. Our ability to scale from Series A through commercialization depends on hiring the right people, at the right pace, into the right roles — across fusion science, laser engineering, software, operations, and G&A. You won't inherit a finished machine. You'll build one. What You'll Do Team Leadership Lead and develop five TA Partners and the TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a high-performing team culture that delivers without you in every decision. Hiring Standards and Rigour Build and maintain the TA operating standards: hiring processes, interview frameworks, scorecards, and decision criteria applied consistently across every function. Raise the bar on quality, not just throughput. Capacity Planning Drive capacity planning in close partnership with Finance and department heads, ensuring TA is resourced and sequenced ahead of demand — never the bottleneck to a planned hire. Hiring Manager Enablement Equip leaders to run structured, fair hiring processes through training, coaching, and tooling — reducing dependency on TA for process guidance and raising the quality of hiring decisions. ATS and Data Own the ATS end to end: configuration, data integrity, adoption, and continuous improvement. Use pipeline data and KPIs to identify bottlenecks, drive process changes, and report progress that drives decisions rather than decorates them. Employer Branding Build a consistent, differentiated presence in our target talent markets — LinkedIn, Glassdoor, job boards, events, and content — in partnership with Marketing, so inbound quality improves quarter on quarter. Who You Are • 10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with meaningful time leading and developing recruiting teams • Experience in a scaling tech, deep-tech, or engineering-heavy environment, hiring for specialised, hard-to-fill roles • Fluent with AI in your daily recruiting work — sourcing, screening, content, analytics — and able to raise your team's bar on it • A KPI-driven operator: structured interviewing, assessment design, capacity planning, and hiring manager enablement are core methods, not buzzwords • Hands-on ATS ownership: configuration, vendor management, reporting, and driving adoption across recruiters and hiring managers • Strong working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to candidate data, and of German employment law in hiring • Fluent in English; German is a meaningful plus What Sets You Apart • You've built or significantly rebuilt a TA operating model — standards, processes, and team structure — in a company that doubled headcount • You've made employer branding work in a competitive talent market, with results you can point to • You have a point of view on what great talent acquisition looks like — and it's grounded in outcomes, not activity • You're drawn to mission-driven companies and want your work to connect to something larger than the next quarter Why This Role • Own the function that most directly gates the growth of one of the most ambitious clean energy ventures in the world • Build the hiring engine that carries a science-driven company from Series A through commercialization • A leadership team that treats People as a strategic function, not a support desk • Competitive compensation, equity participation, and benefits reflective of the talent bar we hold What We Offer • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery. • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career. • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges. • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company. • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together. • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year. • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily. • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives. • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace. • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs — whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing, you choose what fits your lifestyle. • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits. title: Product Manager: Customer Onboarding Experience
description: About You You are a technically fluent, customer-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You have a strong instinct for what makes integrations feel fast and safe, and you know how to balance developer needs with long-term product maintainability. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time-to-value for the teams and customers who depend on you. About Us Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. About the Position As the PM for Customer Developer Experience + Customer Data Integrations, you will own the end-to-end integration journey for Constructor's customers and SIs — from first setup through long-term adoption. Your north star is time-to-value: making it fast, correct, and reliable for any team to integrate with Constructor and start getting results. You will span two tightly connected surfaces: CDX — SDKs, UI libraries, integration patterns, docs, and the extensibility model that lets customers build on Constructor without accumulating hidden complexity. CDI — tracking/instrumentation, data attributes, event validation tooling, and the reliability + correctness of the data flows that power Constructor's AI. Day-to-day, you will: Define and drive a roadmap that measurably reduces integration time, defects, and escalations. Improve integration correctness for key tracking flows (search → PDP → conversion, sponsored click tracking, etc.) by reducing common failure modes and adding robust validation and diagnostics. Build and evolve validation and debugging tooling that empowers customers, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success to self-serve faster. Define clear support and capability boundaries to reduce high-visibility escalations and improve customer predictability. Partner with Engineering, Solutions/CS, and other Product teams to sequence work, de-risk launches, and ensure new capabilities ship integration-ready. Define and report a CDX+CDI KPI stack (time-to-first-value, adoption, defect rate, escalation volume, doc findability) and drive continuous improvement. Requirements 3+ years of product management experience shipping developer-facing or integration-heavy products — such as SDKs, APIs, web tracking/instrumentation, data pipelines, or developer tooling. Demonstrated ability to reduce time-to-value or integration complexity in a B2B SaaS environment — with concrete, measurable outcomes. Technical fluency sufficient to reason credibly about event flows, browser/web constraints, attribution, versioning, breaking changes, and rollout risk — without needing to be an engineer. Track record of strong cross-functional collaboration: aligning Engineering, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Product teams on priorities and support boundaries. Comfort defining metrics and making decisions with imperfect data; experience building and reporting product health dashboards. Strong written communication — clear specs, integration guides, capability docs, and stakeholder updates. We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact 🏥 Company sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee) Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. API Integration & OpenAPI Proficiency: Strong capability in consuming and integrating with complex RESTful APIs . Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und internen Teams steuerst du Projekte von der Planung bis zum Go-live, löst technische Herausforderungen und baust langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf.

Klingt nach der richtigen Herausforderung für dich? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Du kannst an einem unserer deutschen Standorte oder deutschlandweit remote aus dem Homeoffice arbeiten.

Implementierung & Projektmanagement

Technischer Support & Lösungsberatung
  • Du bearbeitest anspruchsvolle Kundenanfragen im 2nd-Level-Support.
  • Du analysierst technische Fehlerbilder und unterstützt bei der Ursachenanalyse in Datenbanken, Logfiles und bestehenden Systemen.

Kundenbetreuung & Customer Success
  • Du begleitest Kunden entlang ihres gesamten Lifecycles – von der Implementierung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
  • Du führst Schulungen und Anwendertrainings durch.
  • Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und berätst Kunden bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Prozesse.

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, beispielsweise als Application Consultant, Implementation Consultant, Technical Consultant, IT-Projektmanager, Support Consultant oder Customer Success Manager im Softwareumfeld.

International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. In this role, you get real hands‑on experience in how risk management works inside a regulated fintech. title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass).   • End-to-end product ownership, driving ideas from concept to customer-ready production

  • Proactive execution in ambiguous environments, turning unclear requirements into shipped software

  • High-speed delivery paired with a focus on clean code and scalable architecture

  • Close iteration with users and clients, including collaboration across different cultures

  • Strong experience with full-stack software engineering, especially React and TypeScript, with excellent understanding of constructing user flows

  • Cloud and DevOps experience with Docker

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a <span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW257253422 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW257253422 BCX8">Senior Social Executive</span></span> at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Senior Social Executive, you will play a key role in shaping and executing our social media strategy across multiple platforms. You will&nbsp;be responsible for&nbsp;creating culturally relevant, insight-led content that drives brand awareness,&nbsp;engagement&nbsp;and community growth, while ensuring LOOKFANTASTIC&nbsp;remains&nbsp;at the forefront of social trends and platform innovation.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role requires someone who lives and breathes social media, with their finger firmly on the pulse of emerging trends, content formats, creator&nbsp;activity&nbsp;and cultural moments. You will combine creative thinking with performance insights to&nbsp;identify&nbsp;opportunities, optimise content&nbsp;strategies&nbsp;and continuously improve results across both organic and paid channels.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Working closely with Brand, Creative, Influencer,&nbsp;CRM&nbsp;and Paid Media teams, you will translate audience behaviours and platform learnings into content that resonates with consumers and supports wider business&nbsp;objectives. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.</p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776"><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776"></p> <p>We are looking to hire a Senior Events Manager to join our Brand Marketing team at Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand. In this senior role, you’ll take ownership of our end-to-end events strategy – leading a dynamic events calendar from concept through delivery, managing and developing a team of event professionals, and setting the standard for high-impact, brand-defining activations. With a strong focus on B2B and influencer-led events, you’ll build and maintain relationships with senior industry partners, stakeholders, and clients, shaping how the brand shows up at every touchpoint. You’ll partner closely with senior leadership, internal teams, and external partners to translate business objectives into bold event concepts delivered at scale.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Events and Activations strategy &amp; calendar ownership</li> <li>Team leadership, coaching &amp; development</li> <li>Budget ownership per activation</li> <li>Senior stakeholder &amp; leadership engagement</li> <li>Supplier &amp; vendor negotiation at scale</li> <li>B2B &amp; flagship event execution</li> <li>On-site event leadership</li> <li>Speaker, talent &amp; influencer partnerships (in collaboration with the influencer team)</li> <li>Brand direction for event materials &amp; creative</li> <li>Multi-market event roll-out</li> <li>Logistics, scheduling &amp; risk management</li> <li>Permits, compliance &amp; health and safety</li> <li>Post-event reporting, ROI analysis &amp; insight sharing</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Look For your Skills, Knowledge and Experience:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Events Manager who leads from the front – someone who thrives under pressure, is energised by a fast-paced environment, and brings both strategic thinking and hands-on delivery to everything they do. You’ll have a sharp eye for industry trends, a track record of developing others, and the confidence to represent the brand in front of senior stakeholders.</p> <ul> <li>Experience: 5 years of event management experience, including experience operating at a senior or leadership level, ideally within a brand marketing, retail, or corporate environment.</li> <li>Brand Events: Proven track record multiple complex, high-profile events simultaneously, from concept to execution.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Confident operating with senior stakeholders, internal teams, external partners, and description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.</p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">About Cult Beauty&nbsp;<br></span></strong></p> <p>Cult Beauty is one of the UK's leading online beauty destinations, known for a curated, expert-led edit of the best emerging and established beauty brands. As part of THG, Cult Beauty combines an entrepreneurial, fast-moving culture with the scale, data and technology of a global e-commerce group. The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12–24 months.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Affiliates &amp; Partnerships Manager at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Affiliates &amp; Partnerships Manager to take ownership of Cult Beauty's affiliate channel and lead its next phase of growth. This is a hands-on role; you'll set the strategy and own the numbers. You will also be in the detail, planning activations, negotiating placements, managing budgets in real time, and reporting on performance. It suits someone who is equally comfortable building a forecast model as they are briefing a publisher or optimising a live campaign.</p> <p>You'll own the channel's budget end-to-end, from annual and quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month tracking, reforecasting and reconciliation against actuals, while also executing the campaigns and activations that bring the strategy to life. You'll use data, including media mix modelling (MMM) and other cross-channel measurement, to understand the channel's true incremental contribution and its role in the wider marketing mix, and you'll look for opportunities for the channel to support broader brand awareness goals, not just direct performance.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">As </span><em><span data-contrast="auto"> Senior Affiliates &amp; Partnerships Manager</span></em><span data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;you’ll:&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Channel strategy &amp; scale</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the affiliate and partnerships strategy for Cult Beauty, identifying and prioritising the highest-value opportunities to scale reach, revenue and new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Build the channel out from its current base, expanding the partner mix across content, cashback, loyalty, influencer-affiliate and technology partners, while protecting margin and brand value.</li> <li>Identify and develop opportunities for the channel to support wider brand awareness objectives, working with brand and content teams to use partnerships (e.g. content, video and influencer-affiliate placements) to build reach and consideration alongside direct performance.</li> <li>Keep the channel's commercial model, commission structure and partner tiering under continuous review, benchmarking against market practice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Budget planning, forecasting &amp; management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead annual and quarterly budget planning and revenue/commission forecasting for the channel, working closely with finance and the wider marketing leadership team.</li> <li>Own in-month budget management and pacing, tracking spend and commission against forecast, reforecasting as needed, and flagging variances before they become a problem.</li> <li>Build and maintain robust forecasting models that link activity, seasonality and commercial terms to expected return, and use these to make the case for investment.</li> <li>Apply media mix modelling (MMM) outputs and other cross-channel measurement to inform budget allocation, understand the channel's incremental contribution, and stress-test planning assumptions against the wider marketing mix.</li> <li>Reconcile monthly performance against budget and finance records, ensuring accurate, timely reporting on channel P&amp;L.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Activation execution &amp; campaign management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan and execute the affiliate activation calendar, from always-on placements through to peak trading moments (e.g. Black Friday, Cyber Monday, key beauty launches) and brand awareness activity.</li> <li>Brief, negotiate and manage relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, content creators and technology partners to secure high-quality, cost-effective placements.</li> <li>Own day-to-day channel operations: commission structuring, tracking and validation, compliance, and troubleshooting technical or performance issues.</li> <li>Use AI-driven tools and optimization, for example automated bid/commission optimisation, AI-assisted content, creative or audience targeting to improve campaign efficiency and free up time for strategic activity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data, insight &amp; reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use data to drive decisions across the channel, analysing performance by partner, placement and campaign to identify what's working and reallocate budget accordingly.</li> <li>Own regular and ad hoc reporting for senior stakeholders, translating channel performance into clear commercial insight and recommendations.</li> <li>Partner with wider analytics/BI teams to improve attribution, measurement and incrementality understanding for the channel.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, coach and develop the affiliates team, setting clear priorities and creating capacity to scale as the channel grows.</li> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for the affiliates channel with cross-functional teams, including brand, finance and commercial, ensuring alignment on priorities and investment.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with other marketing channels, including paid social, PR, influencer and CRM to align messaging, avoid duplication of partner relationships, and ensure affiliate activity is planned as part of an integrated, cross-channel marketing calendar.</li> <li>Represent Cult Beauty externally with networks, agencies and partners, building a reputation as a commercially sharp, collaborative partner.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience managing an affiliate/partnerships channel in a fast-paced e-commerce, retail or beauty environment, ideally at Manager level or above already.</li> <li>Strong data acumen: confident building and interrogating models in Excel/Google Sheets, comfortable working across GA4/BI tools and media mix modelling (MMM) or cross-channel measurement outputs, and able to translate data into a clear commercial story.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience owning a budget end-to-end: annual/quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month management, pacing and reconciliation with finance.</li> <li>Hands-on experience planning and executing affiliate activations and campaigns, not just overseeing them but comfortable being close to the detail.</li> <li>Working knowledge of affiliate networks and tracking platforms (e.g. Awin, Rakuten Advertising, Partnerize, Impact, CJ) and the wider creator-commerce landscape.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI and automation tools to optimise campaigns, spend and content at scale, and keen to test new tools as the affiliate/AI-commerce landscape evolves.</li> <li>Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with experience managing partner and network relationships.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams and influence senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in beauty, fashion or a related lifestyle retail category.</li> <li>Experience scaling a channel or building out a partner programme from a smaller base.</li> <li>Familiarity with media mix modelling (MMM), attribution or incrementality methodologies and testing frameworks.</li> <li>Experience using partnerships or affiliate activity to support brand awareness and upper-funnel objectives, alongside performance/direct-response activity.</li> <li>Line management or mentoring experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analytical and commercially minded, with genuine curiosity about what the numbers are telling you.</li> <li>Organised and comfortable owning a budget with real accountability for the numbers.</li> <li>A doer as well as a strategist, happy to plan the activation and then get it live.</li> <li>A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly with partners and colleagues across the wider business.<br> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days a week on site. You'll collaborate with colleagues in our Manchester office as needed, with occasional travel between sites.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong><span title: Business Development Executive (Graduate Opportunity)
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Business Development Executive</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong>Sydney (hybrid working)&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Axiom:</strong></p> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">As the leading alternative legal services provider globally,&nbsp;</span><a href="https://www.axiomlaw.com/" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="f2cfc5ca-ba3e-47dd-8d11-b247352d64eb" data-linkindex="0">Axiom</a>&nbsp;gives in-house legal teams on-demand access to top legal talent and lawyers — deployed when, where, and how clients need it, for up to 50% less than national law firms. Axiom's network of 14,000+ legal professionals includes 4,000+ lawyers with Fortune 500 experience, delivering AI-enabled legal services across more than 12 practice areas. Trusted by 75% of the Fortune 100 and thousands of mid-market leaders, Axiom ranks #1 among Alternative Legal Service Providers in 8 of 9 performance categories — including talent quality, breadth, productivity, and client experience — according to a top 5 global consulting firm. Across more than 3,000 engagements annually in 6 regions and 4 continents, 93% of clients rate Axiom lawyers as good as or better than top law firm attorneys, with 96% client satisfaction and measurable cost savings that reduce outside counsel spend without sacrificing quality. Stop overpaying for law firm work.&nbsp;<strong>Start with Axiom.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As we continue our expansion, we’re looking for a team member who can share Axiom’s story with prospective clients and set up revenue-generating meeting opportunities for the sales team. This is a position for an aspiring sales professional who is excited to jump-start their career as a Business Development Representative. Our ideal candidate is someone who loves to connect with sophisticated stakeholders, exhibits outstanding judgment, maturity, confidence, and professionalism, and thrives in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment within a close-knit team.</p> <p>Specifically, this role will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Strategically researching/identifying potential client contacts, generating leads, and uncovering high-value opportunities</li> <li>Communicating Axiom’s business model to potential clients in an impactful way and demonstrating why a meeting with Axiom would be beneficial to their business</li> <li>Driving business through outbound phone calls, preparing and sending strategic e-mails to prospective clients specific to their business or legal needs</li> <li>Successfully diagnosing the client’s key business needs to ensure a high quality of interaction in the first sales meeting</li> <li>Supporting Sales in all aspects of the sales cycle, including scheduling follow-up meetings and managing the pipelines of completed meetings to ensure all prospective clients are being contacted throughout the year</li> <li>Working with local and central marketing teams to create external marketing materials to engage prospective clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <p>First and foremost, successful candidates must be fits for our unique operating environment and culture: high-growth, innovative, lean, and values-driven.&nbsp; As such, successful candidates must be ready to develop professionally, serious about pursuing a career in sales, and highly capable in each the following dimensions (among others): adaptability, curiosity, resourcefulness, analytical thinking/problem solving, proactivity, taking initiative, teamwork, thought leadership, credibility, and operating with/through a lean team.</p> <p>Beyond these characteristics, here are the required skills, knowledge, capabilities, and education:</p> <ul> <li>Goal and action orientation, with a sense of urgency, drive, and commitment to routinely exceed monthly activity metrics</li> <li>Exemplary service ethic when contributing to individual and team goals</li> <li>Highly persuasive verbal communication skills, and excellent written communication skills</li> <li>Poise, confidence, and maturity to interact with senior client levels</li> <li>Tenacity and resilience with a will to keep going despite rejections</li> <li>Forward-thinking and solutions-oriented approach at all times</li> <li>Strong MS office skills</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree from an accredited school or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Our new hires: &nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Receive hands-on coaching from a direct manager and a mentor.</li> <li>Embrace real responsibility: tangible meeting goals, relationships with executive-level clients at Fortune 500 companies, and leadership opportunities.</li> <li>Nurture their ongoing career goals inside of a talent-incubating team that has boasted over 15 promotions in the past 2 years.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: </strong>Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at <a ---------- and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior VFX Artist & Animation Generalist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are: </strong></p> <p>Gram Games is the studio behind popular titles like 1010!, Six!, Merge Dragons!, and Merge Magic!, with more exciting projects in the pipeline. We are proudly part of the Zynga &amp; Take-Two Interactive family. We do things differently here: we work in small self-managing teams, giving you an incredible amount of ownership, autonomy, and impact.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Gram, everyone is expected to have a razor-sharp focus on creating a tangible impact on their team, their work environment, and on the overall company strategy. If you are motivated by autonomy, constant improvement, collaboration, and a sense of belonging, this is the place for you.</p></div><p>The New Games team is looking for a highly skilled Senior VFX &amp; Animation Generalist to join us. This is a hands-on and creative role for someone who can take visual effects and motion design from ideation to final in-game implementation. You will help design, build, and polish the VFX and motion language of the game, working closely with art, design, tech art, engineering, and production.</p> <p>Crucially, we need someone who can take full ownership of the pipeline that drives the dynamic, deeply satisfying VFX and interactions seen in top-tier, highly polished casual puzzle games. We are looking for a generalist who combines strong artistic judgment with deep hands-on Unity experience.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own, build, and optimize the VFX and animation pipeline, establishing efficient workflows tailored to producing the highly dynamic and rewarding interactions expected in top-tier casual puzzle games.</li> <li>Create high-quality VFX and animations from ideation, concept, and visual exploration through to final implementation in Unity.</li> <li>Design and implement "juicy" interactions and celebratory effects that make every player interaction feel incredibly tactile and satisfying.</li> <li>Bring your own creative ideas to the table to make the puzzle pieces, UI, environments, and effects feel alive and responsive.</li> <li>Work hands-on with modern Unity workflows, including the Animation timeline, Particle System, Shader Graph, URP, custom materials, and animation-driven effects.</li> <li>Translate concepts, prototypes, gameplay needs, and rough ideas into clear, polished in-engine effects and motion.</li> <li>Optimize VFX and animations for mobile, balancing visual ambition with performance, memory, readability, and production constraints.</li> <li>Identify visual, technical, and workflow bottlenecks in the pipeline, and propose practical solutions.</li> <li>Collaborate with tech art and ElevenLabs spends meaningfully on paid acquisition, and that spend is only as good as the data behind it. We are looking for an engineer to own our measurement layer end to end: the tag manager setup, the tracking and attribution scripts on our sites, and the server-to-server conversion tracking that feeds our ad platforms.

Day to day you will work closely with the paid marketing team: fixing tracking bugs as they come in, setting up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debugging discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data. Longer term, you will define how tracking should properly work here and build the monitoring so we catch breakage in hours, not weeks.

This role sits between frontend engineering, data engineering, and marketing. You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.

What you will do

  • Own our tag manager setup end to end, including the server-side GTM container, and review any changes other teams want to make

  • Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data

  • Build and maintain server-to-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication

  • Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget

  • Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets

  • Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default

  • Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks

  • Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations

Requirements

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase

  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM, and at least one conversion API (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or similar) implemented server-to-server

  • Experience debugging attribution discrepancies end to end: pixel vs server deduplication, UTM conventions, event schema design

  • Solid understanding of web performance and how to add tracking without degrading Core Web Vitals

  • Working knowledge of consent and privacy requirements (Consent Mode v2, regional restrictions) and SQL for validating tracking data in the warehouse

Bonus

  • CDP experience (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow)

  • Product analytics tools (GA4, Amplitude, PostHog) and dbt

  • Next.js experience

  • Exposure to incrementality testing or media mix modelling

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own the whole martech and measurement area as it grows, potentially leading a small marketing engineering team

  • Grow toward senior/staff IC on the engineering track

  • Broaden into data engineering and attribution modelling, or into growth engineering more widely (experimentation, landing page infrastructure)

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

  • Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

  • Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

  • Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

  • Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

  • Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

  • Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

  • Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

  • Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time

 

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

 

  • Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad

  • Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

  • Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals

  • Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building API products, data platforms, or data distribution products at a B2B company

  • Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful

  • Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding

  • Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake

  • Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions

  • Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how enterprise data buyers evaluate providers, and you can shape a product that competes on data quality, coverage, and ease of integration

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical and commercial audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or how buy-side/sell-side firms consume financial data

  • Experience with Snowflake data sharing, marketplace listings, or similar cloud data distribution mechanisms

  • Experience building entitlements, licensing, or access control systems for data products

  • Understanding of data licensing, redistribution terms, or AI usage policies in the context of enterprise data products

 

Benefits

 

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked salary

  • Pension with 7% company matching

  • Private medical insurance, paid sick leave, income protection, group life assurance

  • Season ticket and cycle-to-work schemes

  • Hybrid flexibility with up to 3 months annual work abroad

  • 25 holiday days plus local public holidays (exchangeable)

  • One-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; enhanced parental leave

  • Professional development budget and regular social events

Act as the point of escalation for your team, and proactively surface and resolve risks and dependencies.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering management experience (essential):</strong> a track record of leading, growing, engaging, and retaining a high-performing software/systems team — including hiring, coaching, feedback, and performance management. People management is your first priority.</li> <li><strong>Delivery through a team:</strong> experience owning a team's roadmap and shipping through others — planning, prioritization, resourcing, and accountability for quality and operational reliability.</li> <li><strong>Technical credibility:</strong> hands-on depth in what takes to architect and deliver embedded software shipped on a product to real customers. Demonstrate knowledge of high-performance, low-latency embedded software (C++) to earn the trust of senior systems engineers and own the team's technical decisions. You don't need to be the team's top individual contributor.</li> <li><strong>Performance &amp; systems fundamentals:</strong> solid understanding of profiling, benchmarking, latency/throughput/memory-bandwidth analysis, and real-time scheduling, on embedded Linux (ideally also QNX).</li> <li><strong>IPC / middleware:</strong> a strong grasp of middleware for high-throughput real-time or robotics systems and the trade-offs across vendors and platforms.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional leadership:</strong> the ability to set direction and deliver through influence across many stakeholder teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience in automotive, robotics, or another safety-relevant real-time domain.</li> <li>Familiarity with profiling toolchains (pprof/gperftools, perf, Nsight, NVLumo) and observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog).</li> <li>Experience with NVIDIA (Orin/Thor) and/or Qualcomm compute platforms.</li> <li>Experience with a micro-kernel and/or real-time OS (e.g. QNX) is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>Why this team</h2> <p>The Runtime Platform team supports Wayve's on-vehicle stack — other on-board components rely on the frameworks, performance, observability, and layers it owns. raw.description:
About the job

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

 

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. Your role here isn't just to hit a number, it's to help redefine how an entire market discovers what's possible, and to build the commercial engine that gets us there.

Founded in 2024, we've already gained the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others.

Our early traction enabled us to raise £2.6m in funding and we're now looking to scale faster. We're moving from founder-led sales to a repeatable growth engine and we want someone who has built that engine before, not someone building it for the first time.

 

The Basics

📍 Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

⏱️ Experience: 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales/GTM, including time spent building process, tooling, or a team from scratch

🧑‍💼 Reports to: Founders

💰 Pay: Competitive base with uncapped, meaningful upside plus equity

🥇 The role: Lead our commercial engine, own pipeline generation, close new business, and build the playbooks, tooling, and team structure that let us scale beyond founder-led sales

 

The Role

This is the role that builds and runs Adclear's UK commercial engine. We spent two years building a genuine community, a content engine, events and a strong network a lot of what you touch is already warm. But we need someone who's done more than work a warm desk: someone who has stood up a GTM motion before, knows what "repeatable" actually looks like, and can operate directly with founders without a playbook handed to them.

You'll close net-new business yourself, own the full cycle from outbound through to signed retainer, and build the systems - CRM, sequencing, reporting that let the function scale past you. As we grow, you'll be first in line to build and lead the team underneath this role.

You'll sell with the best growth tooling available. We invest in the stack so your time goes where it counts: in front of prospects and building the machine. We use Attio as our CRM, Clay for rev ops, Sales Nav for prospecting, Lemlist for outreach and we're building a fully AI-enabled stack that automates the busywork.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the full GTM cycle end-to-end: ICP definition, outbound, discovery, pilot, close, and retainer conversion

  • Build and own the CRM, sequencing infrastructure, content-to-pipeline flow, and commercial playbook from the ground up

  • Run daily outbound across calls, email and LinkedIn, with phone/in-person meetings as your first move, not your last resort

  • Work our warm engine - content, events, podcast and community leads and convert events into pipeline yourself

  • Check inbound signals daily (website visits, demo sign-ups, content downloads) and act on what matters

  • Partner directly with the founders on pricing, positioning, and GTM strategy

  • Start building the hiring plan and playbook for the team you'll lead as the function scales

  • Report on pipeline health, conversion, and what's working well enough to double down on

 

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • You've closed net-new business personally and can point to a repeatable process behind it

  • You've built (or meaningfully upgraded) the CRM, sequencing, and reporting infrastructure the team runs on

  • You're operating with high autonomy and are trusted to make GTM strategy calls with the founders

  • You've made the case for, and started building, the team underneath you

 

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales or GTM, with a track record of building not just executing, process, tooling, or a team

  • Demonstrated ownership of a full commercial cycle: prospecting through close, ideally including team leadership or cross-functional GTM strategy work

  • Phone-first and comfortable in person you don't hide behind email and LinkedIn

  • Evidence of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in a scaling environment, with numbers to back it up

  • Genuine self-starter who's operated with minimal playbook before and built one from scratch

  • Sharp enough to hold a real conversation about a technical, regulated product without needing to be an expert on day one

  • Comfortable reporting directly to founders and operating with significant autonomy

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience selling into regulated industries: fintech, legaltech, or healthtech

  • Experience building or scaling an outbound or broker/referral channel from zero

  • Prior experience as a founding or early commercial hire at a startup

  • Direct experience owning or building CRM/rev-ops infrastructure

  • An established personal presence or content instinct on LinkedIn

 

How We Work

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day

  • No rigid script: you test, learn and adapt on your own initiative

  • You own your pipeline end-to-end, including follow-through after a meeting is booked

  • The pace is fast and the approach is still being built you're one of the people building it

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula handed to you on day one

 

Benefits

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Direct path to building and leading the commercial team as we scale

raw.title: Financial Auditor – Product & Methodology
raw.description:
About Cortea

We're Cortea, a European audit-tech company, born in Berlin, rebuilding how audits are done everywhere.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we're at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea's future, and how audits are done.

The Role

This is a role for an auditor with a deep interest in audit methodology: someone who knows the standards in detail, recognises where they leave room for interpretation, and wants to build the tools they always wished they had. Someone who is curious about the newest tools and tech trends entering the ecosystem, and has built a point of view on how the industry can best be served by tech, AI and innovation. Reporting into Philipp (Co-Founder), you sit closer to the product than a typical audit hire: you translate audit methodology into structured logic, write and refine the prompts that drive our AI workflows, and work day to day with our engineering team in Berlin to shape how audit logic is built, tested, and shipped. No programming background is required. What matters is rigorous process thinking and a deep understanding of how audits actually get done.

Key Responsibilities

Product Shaping: Work as a standing part of the product process: join reviews and design sessions, give hands-on feedback on prototypes, and help prioritise the roadmap

Methodology to Logic: Translate complex ISA (UK) and international auditing standards into structured, executable logic our product and engineering team can build directly into the platform

Prompt Engineering: Write, test, and refine the prompts and decision logic that drive our AI audit workflows

Documentation Quality: Ensure audit documentation quality aligns with ISA (UK) 230 and related documentation requirements, and that system outputs stand up to internal quality control and external review

Independence & Ethics: Safeguard auditor independence and ensure the product complies with the FRC Ethical Standard and ICAEW/ACCA Code of Ethics

Berlin Collaboration: Travel regularly to our Berlin hub to work in person with Philipp and the product and engineering team


Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of financial audit experience (Big 4 or leading mid-tier firms preferred), including time at audit manager level with a solid understanding of engagement responsibility and audit risk

  • ACA (ICAEW), ACCA, or equivalent chartered accountancy qualification

  • A strong interest in audit methodology: you enjoy turning abstract standards into clear, reproducible logic

  • A tech-first mindset and a proven willingness to leverage, experiment with, or build new tools, with relentless curiosity for how AI and innovation can improve work and outcomes

  • Ability to sketch decision trees and define structured, unambiguous process outputs; comfortable writing and iterating on AI prompts

  • No programming background required, but you think in processes, dependencies, and system logic, and enjoy working closely with engineers day to day

  • Strong grasp of ISA (UK), UK GAAP (FRS 102), IFRS, and the Companies Act 2006

  • Native in English, German is a plus

  • Right to work in the UK required; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity participation

  • The chance to build the tools you always wished you'd had as an auditor, with direct influence over product direction

  • Hybrid collaboration from our London office, with regular trips to our Berlin hub

  • 25+ days holiday allowance

  • Pension contribution

  • Private medical insurance

Interview Process

  • Technical audit & methodology interview with Philipp (Co-Founder)

  • Strategic & Collaboration Fit interview with Valentin (Co-Founder)
